messages:
maria: Quick sync — pushing sprint scope for private deploys. Field asks keep growing: customer-managed NAT, IP preservation during upgrades, and an offline package for air-gapped installs. Need to land a prioritized checklist by EOW.

emily: I put together a candidate launch gate list. high level: security signoff (KMS/HSM), upgrade path docs, migration playbook, 2 pilot customers, and zero-downtime demo. Want to validate with field.

raj: From infra: biggest risk is stateful networking during node replacement. We can preserve customer IPs if we support host-network mode + static MACs in the installer, but that adds packaging complexity.

hannah: Field note — large banks will only accept IP-preserve if we guarantee <2min failover and clear rollback steps. They will also request a runbook that shows exact iptables/sysctl changes.

maria: prioritize: (1) IP-preserve upgrade test harness, (2) offline artifact signing, (3) KMS plugin docs, (4) pilot checklist. Can we scope (1) into this sprint?

raj: We can deliver a test harness but it needs a new agent handshake flow: the tenant-agent must assert networking mode and persist IP binding before upgrade. Prototype in 3 days.

emily: OK — make the handshake flow explicit in the playbook. Add an acceptance test: run upgrade with 500 concurrent sessions, verify <2min traffic disruption and no IP changes.

maria: also need legal/contract note about IP preservation guarantees. dave, can you flag any compliance blockers?

dave: KMS/HSM: customers ask for BYOK + audit logs retained 1y. Our Private control plane supports BYOK, but on-prem/pure-airgap requires a local KMS shim and documented HSM integration steps. We should add that to launch criteria.

hannah: pilot ask: one customer on VPC + one fully air-gapped. If both pass, that's a strong signal. Field can run acceptance tests and give written signoff.

raj: Packaging decision: offer two installers — containerized operator (recommended) and an offline tarball for airgap. Tarball will include a minimal rwd-agent binary and installer script. Tarball size should be <250MB.

maria: Good. Add rollout policy: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on <90% session success. Include a manual abort step for customers.

deploy-bot: deployment-note: recorded a new template: `private-upgrade-handshake-v1` (artifact id: rwd-upg-202503).

emily: UX/Docs ask — create a concise checklist: preflight network test, KMS config, IP preservation verification, rollback steps, and contact points for escalation. Docs should include exact commands.

raj: Example handshake command (will be in docs):
```
rwdctl handshake --mode vpc --preserve-ips=true --agent-token $TOKEN
```
Also provisioning snippet for offline install:
```
./install.sh --offline --artifact ./rwd-private-1.2.0.tar.gz --kms-shim /opt/kms-shim
```

maria: Final call: sprint scope = prototype handshake + test harness + tarball pipeline + pilot-ready playbook. Can we commit?

raj: committing to handshake prototype + harness. Tarball pipeline MVP will be scoped to a follow-up if infra needs more time.

emily: I'll draft the playbook and checklist today, tag legal and security for signoff.

hannah: Field will line up two pilot customers and draft acceptance criteria.

dave: I'll start the HSM integration doc and list required audit fields.

maria: Great. Action items assigned. We'll review progress in tomorrow standup. :thumbsup:
